reply.answer_text: Yes. A loan-trust bond must register on HMRC's Trust Registration Service (TRS). Bonds have surrender values, so they do not qualify for the protection-policy exclusion. Trustees must keep their registration current (90-day change window) and provide Aldercrest with proof of registration — the URN.
